links.note: Premise is that a child read the sea because of a school lesson while the adults could not; 31553 is that contrast (Penny watching the beach shrink and not knowing what was happening). The set has no concept for Tilly's geography lesson itself, and 31554 is only the aftermath of awards.

Whether Ignesious anticipated a tsunami - answered No - is exactly 31541's point: he stopped to set the television safely on the floor, which shows how little anyone understood what was coming. 31540 is only the wife's earthquake warning.
The policeman of the Katchall account is Sanjeev, named in 31545 (the stem's 'Sachin' is a slip). 31544 is whose cries he heard; this item identifies the man himself.
Whom he tried to save - the guesthouse cook's wife - is 31544, the cries for help. 31545 is the jump and its outcome.
Whether the rescue succeeded (no - both were swept away) is 31545. 31544 is only hearing her call.
John is identified as the guesthouse cook inside 31544. 31545 names Sanjeev, not John.
Meghna's parents were carried off with seventy-seven others - 31546. 31547 is her own two days on the door.
The wooden door she held is 31547; the log in 31551 is Almas's, which is the distractor this item is built on.
Two days afloat is stated in 31547. 31548 is the helicopters during those days.
How she was finally rescued - washed ashore by a wave, not by the helicopters - is the point of 31548, where help was present and useless. No concept describes the landing itself.
Her age, thirteen, is given in 31546 with the seventy-seven others.
Almas being ten is part of 31549, her introduction. 31551 is her survival on the log.
Her father's petrol pump at Port Blair is in 31549. 31550 is what her father did when the water receded.
She lived at Port Blair and had travelled to Nancowry for Christmas - both in 31549, and the island distinction is what the distractor tests.
Almas on the floating log is the close of 31551, whose first half is the coconut tree her mother and aunts clung to.

Identifying the still-traumatised girl as Almas turns on what she lost - her mother and aunts washed away with the uprooted tree, 31551. Meghna's ordeal (31547-31548) and Tilly's (31552-31554) are the distractors.
The Smiths being from south-east England is stated in 31552. 31553 is Penny's account on the beach.
Taking refuge on the hotel's third floor is the end of the beach escape that 31553 covers; no concept in this set records the hotel separately. 31554 is the later refusal to make her a heroine.
The claim that wild and domestic animals seemed to know is the animal-behaviour beat, 31555, which lists what they did. 31556 is the proposed explanation and 31557 the evidence's limits.
The reason offered - a sixth sense, acute hearing, feeling the earth's vibration - is 31556. 31557 is the death-toll evidence, and 31555 the behaviour itself.
The Galle dogs refusing to go out is one of 31555's listed behaviours. 31556 is why they might have known.
